contracts.source: Twist Bioscience press release: Twist Bioscience Joins Lilly TuneLab to Advance Antibody (09-16-2026)
contracts.signal: Twist Bioscience announced an agreement with Lilly TuneLab, the collaborative AI/ML drug discovery platform created by Eli Lilly, under which Twist is a provider of antibody characterization data services for TuneLab, including for AbLab, an antibody developability prediction model. TuneLab users will be able to order antibody services from Twist using TuneLab preferred Twist protocols to generate wet lab data, with preferred pricing, and can contribute that data back to TuneLab for federated training. CEO Emily M. Leproust: 'Twist has the scale and high-throughput capabilities to generate consistent and reliable antibody characterization data these models need to be trained on.'
